tools.name: search_msza_ai
tools.description: Searches public, predominantly Polish-language msza.ai sermons, sermon studies, Bible passages, prayers, songs, people, and places by topic, keyword, and relevance. Results retain stored source language and contain candidate matches, stable source IDs, citation labels, short excerpts, dates, and lin

tools.name: get_sermon
tools.description: Returns public sermon text for an exact session ID in its stored language. text_type identifies an AI-edited transcript section, fallback summary, or fallback short thought; these forms are not guaranteed verbatim speech. truncated and total_chars describe text completeness. references contains at m

tools.name: get_daily_page
tools.description: Returns an already-prepared public /dzisiaj briefing for today in the Europe/Warsaw timezone or one YYYY-MM-DD date. The briefing contains a daily thought, readings, patrons, name days, external homilies, and public sermon links. sermon_aggregates_available identifies whether stored synthesis and di

tools.name: list_recent_sermons
tools.description: Returns up to 10 latest public msza.ai sermons in reverse chronological order, optionally limited to one church. This bounded, non-paginated listing contains compact metadata and excerpts.

tools.name: list_sermons_by_date
tools.description: Returns public sermons whose start time falls on one selected Europe/Warsaw calendar day, optionally limited to one church. The non-paginated listing contains at most 50 compact records; total and truncated describe the safety ceiling.

tools.name: get_prayer
tools.description: Returns one saved public prayer-book item: prayer, song, or fixed liturgical text. Bare prayer IDs and namespaced song:<id> and standard:<id> IDs are supported. kind, text_status, and truncated describe content availability; a song can contain only a first line or metadata. rights_note records prove

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Returns one curated Catholic or biblical person profile by exact public person ID. Session-derived dynamic profiles remain unavailable until public provenance is verifiable. Results contain bounded profile fields, canonical source URLs, and at most 20 indexed Scripture references.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Returns one public Catholic or biblical place profile by exact public place ID. Results contain bounded profile fields, canonical source URLs, and at most 20 indexed Scripture references.

tools.name: get_bible_passage
tools.description: Returns up to 50 unchanged UBG verses from one chapter with copyright, license, and source attribution. The local text uses USFM book IDs such as GEN, PSA, MAT, and JHN. No translation or AI generation occurs.

tools.name: list_churches
tools.description: Returns enabled public churches in stable camera ID order, up to 50 per page. next_cursor represents the next page for the same optional literal name/address substring filter; null marks the end. truncated identifies additional matching records. The live catalogue can change during traversal.

tools.name: get_church
tools.description: Returns a saved public church profile by camera_id with bounded description, address, stored Mass schedule, website, and update time. Profiles can be AI-enriched and schedules can be outdated. The result reads saved data without profile refresh or generation.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Returns saved final transcript segments from an ended or interrupted public session rather than an AI-edited sermon section. tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Returns saved parish announcements for an ended or interrupted public session, preferring the edited announcements section and otherwise its summary tab. The response excludes sermon and full-recording fallbacks. text_type identifies AI-edited or summarized text rather than guaranteed verbatim speec

tools.name: get_ai_study
tools.description: Returns one saved public AI study by study_id with its complete public text and source-sermon metadata. tools.name: find_sessions_by_bible_passage
tools.description: Returns public saved recordings whose saved Bible annotations exactly overlap the requested single-chapter verse range. scope=sermon excludes reading-only annotations; scope=session includes other liturgy annotations. tools.name: list_agent_skills
tools.description: Returns up to 50 immutable public Agent Skill summaries from the msza.ai catalogue, optionally filtered by one exact tag. Results contain metadata and canonical links without full Markdown. The catalogue is read-only; publishing belongs to a separate authenticated Hermes endpoint.

tools.name: get_agent_skill
tools.description: Returns one immutable public Agent Skill by exact lowercase slug and optional x.y.z version.
